name: kwrl-mail
description: Kwrl — Fast, quiet, local-first email client with offline Gmail, OS Keychain and local llama.cpp AI

scripts.tauri:dev: cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin kwrl-llm-worker && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin kwrl-llm-worker && tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:mac: cargo build --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --bin kwrl-llm-worker && tauri build --bundles app && cp src-tauri/target/release/kwrl-llm-worker src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos/Kwrl.app/Contents/MacOS/kwrl-llm-worker
